description: This file defines the class `S3SignatureV4` which provides Amazon S3 signature version 4 support, including signing requests and presigning URLs tailored for S3-specific requirements.

classes.name: S3SignatureV4
classes.description: Provides custom signing logic for Amazon S3 signature version 4, including request signing and URL presigning tailored for S3 features and requirements.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs a request with AWS credentials, adding necessary headers and selecting signing method based on hostname.

methods.name: signWithV4a
methods.description: Performs the V4a signing process with custom configuration, mainly for specialized S3 signing needs.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for a request with specific expiry, adding a content hash header if missing.

methods.name: getPresignedPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload used for presigning, mainly indicating an unsigned payload case.

methods.name: createCanonicalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a canonicalized path for signing, ensuring proper encoding for S3 keys.
